compatibility.summary: Approved server 0.27.0/player 0.13.0 milestone includes numeric tables, 40-row ranges, card typography/alignment/padding, and multi-layer geometry tools. Primary modes, ingestion, snapshots, manifests, sync, and updates are unchanged. Older players ignore the new presentation fields and retain earlier row limits/offset behavior; upgrade to player 0.13.0 for all included features. New players retain older publications. Downgrade saves require removing unsupported card fields and reducing maxRows; arrangement uses ordinary coordinates. Feature validation passed 235 Node tests without skips, 97 Python tests, 33 Android JVM tests, and five Chromium suites; release-specific version/compatibility/APK checks, lint, typecheck, production build, repository checks, and dependency audit pass. Hosted build/signing and physical Onn/Pi acceptance are separate results.
